reason: Main method is intraday scalping/day trading of low-float stocks and momentum/theme plays using VWAP, tape and intraday confirmation; swing trades are infrequent A+ additions that do not form a daily-bar testable system.
method_name: Intraday scalping with occasional theme swings
style: scalping and momentum day trading with selective multi-day swings

universe.description: US equities: low-float stocks, OTC names, theme/sector plays (e.g. Bitcoin/blockchain, shipping, marijuana)

setup.rule: Identify theme heating up via trader talk, Twitter, abnormal volume and scanner filters
setup.quote: talking to other traders and sharing ideas and hearing the ideas often all the traders you know when many traders start mentioning the same symbols or the same theme or sector

setup.rule: Focus on sympathy plays after leader has already moved
setup.quote: you always get the leader so you get the first stock that goes and pulls up other stocks in that sector with it and then you get all the sympathy plays

entry.rule: Enter intraday on VWAP break, lower high or change of character; swing entry only after confirmation and during session
entry.quote: if the stock then pulls back to view up and breaks below v wap and trends lower then that's a change of character

stop.rule: Hard stop below key level (resistance turned support or VWAP); overnight short risk limited to prior day's profits
stop.quote: i'll have a stop in place for you know 4 am the next day if it's above a certain price i'll get out at a particular price which will essentially eat up the profits i made the previous day

exits.rule: Scale out on targets or full exit on change of character; pre-written plan with if-then statements
exits.quote: before each swing trade i have a clear plan i know i have my if then statements written out in front of me unless there's a change of character i stick to that

sizing.rule: Intraday: ~10% of daily stop per stock; swing: 50-100% of daily stop on rare A+ setups
sizing.quote: when i trade a swing trade that's a plus i'll allocate 50 percent or 100 to that swing trade

market_filter.rule: Only trade when pre-flight checklist (sleep, food, exercise, fresh) passes and A+ opportunity exists
market_filter.quote: did i sleep well did i have i eaten well did i exercise am i feeling fresh and is there any a plus opportunity on the day

ambiguities.issue: No exact numerical parameters or daily-bar rules provided for any setup
ambiguities.assumption: edge requires intraday data and cannot be approximated on daily bars
